questions.stem: The shop is busy all day. Customers c________ from morning until evening.
questions.hint: Use the three-word phrase meaning arrive and leave again and again.
questions.explanation: Customers repeatedly arrive and leave, so they come and go.
questions.parentExplanation: 顾客不断到来又离开，用come and go；复数主语用原形。

translation.stem: 商店全天都很忙。顾客从早到晚来来去去。

questions.stem: When he misses his parents, the little boy sometimes c________, with tears still on his cheeks.
questions.hint: Use the phrase meaning he cries until he falls asleep; match the reflexive pronoun to the boy.
questions.grammar: cry + 与主语一致的反身代词 + to sleep
questions.explanation: The boy is he, so use himself; cries agrees with the singular subject.
questions.parentExplanation: 男孩用himself；第三人称单数cry变cries，整段为cries himself to sleep。

translation.stem: 想念父母时，小男孩有时哭着入睡，脸上还挂着泪水。

questions.stem: The fans c________ with joy when their team wins the match.
questions.hint: Use a two-word phrase meaning shout loudly.
questions.grammar: cry out；复数主语的一般现在时
questions.explanation: The fans express joy by shouting, which is to cry out.
questions.parentExplanation: 大声叫喊用cry out；复数主语fans配动词原形。

translation.stem: 球队赢得比赛时，球迷们高兴地大声叫喊。

questions.stem: We watch the red balloon r________ the sky above the park.
questions.hint: Use a two-word phrase meaning move upwards and enter the space above.
questions.grammar: watch + 宾语 + 动词原形
questions.explanation: The balloon moves upwards into the sky, so rise into fits after watch the balloon.
questions.parentExplanation: 气球向上进入天空用rise into；watch加宾语后可接动词原形。

translation.stem: 我们看着红气球升入公园上方的天空。

questions.stem: Mum asks Grandpa to w________ the children and keep them safe while she cooks.
questions.hint: Use a two-word phrase meaning look after someone by keeping an eye on them.
questions.explanation: Keeping the children safe by watching them is watching over them.
questions.parentExplanation: 照看孩子并保证安全，用watch over；to后用动词原形。

translation.stem: 妈妈请爷爷在她做饭时照看孩子，确保他们安全。

questions.stem: In the m________ class, we explore new movements instead of following the fixed steps of classical ballet.
questions.hint: Use the two-word name of the expressive dance style contrasted with classical ballet.
questions.explanation: The class explores freer movements, so the named style is modern dance.
questions.parentExplanation: 题干与古典芭蕾固定舞步对比，考查modern dance这一舞种名。

translation.stem: 在现代舞课上，我们探索新的动作，而不是遵循古典芭蕾的固定舞步。

questions.stem: The girl by the door is of m________, standing between her very tall and very short friends.
questions.hint: Describe a person's height when it is in the middle range; use two words.
questions.grammar: of + 描写身高的名词短语
questions.explanation: The contrast with tall and short friends identifies medium height.
questions.parentExplanation: 与很高、很矮的朋友对比，女孩处在中等身高范围。

translation.stem: 门边的女孩中等身高，站在她很高和很矮的朋友中间。

questions.stem: I thought the box was full of books. I________, it only held an empty bag.
questions.hint: used to introduce the real situation
questions.explanation: Here, “In fact” means “used to introduce what is really true”.
questions.parentExplanation: 此处使用“In fact”，保留本来源的词义与词性；完整句意为：我原以为箱子里装满了书。事实上，里面只有一个空包。

passages.text: Our history group visits a historic site with stone steps and an old gate. A guide asks us to look carefully before taking out our notebooks. Mia begins to appreciate the careful work in the small stone patterns. Ben notices worn steps and imagines the many visitors who use them. We sketch the details from the public path without touching or moving anything. Later, we compare our notes and find that each person notices a different detail. The visit teaches us to spend time looking at old places instead of only collecting photographs.

parallelText.en: Our history group visits a historic site with stone steps and an old gate.
parallelText.zh: 我们的历史小组参观一处有石阶和古门的历史遗迹。

parallelText.en: A guide asks us to look carefully before taking out our notebooks.
parallelText.zh: 讲解员请我们先仔细看，再拿出笔记本。

parallelText.en: Mia begins to appreciate the careful work in the small stone patterns.
parallelText.zh: 米娅开始欣赏小小石纹中细致的工艺。

parallelText.en: Ben notices worn steps and imagines the many visitors who use them.
parallelText.zh: 本注意到磨损的台阶，想象使用它们的许多访客。

parallelText.en: We sketch the details from the public path without touching or moving anything.
parallelText.zh: 我们在公共小路上画下细节，不触碰或移动东西。

parallelText.en: Later, we compare our notes and find that each person notices a different detail.
parallelText.zh: 之后，我们比较记录，发现每个人注意的细节都不同。

parallelText.en: The visit teaches us to spend time looking at old places instead of only collecting photographs.
parallelText.zh: 这次参观教会我们花时间观察古老地方，而不只是收集照片。

passages.text: The library invites our class to share a story from a book of literature. The story has two children who disagree about the way to a garden. Mia and I act the parts of the children while another pupil reads the setting. We use different voices to show that one character is worried and the other is confident. After the reading, younger visitors ask why the characters do not check a map together. Their questions help us see a possible solution that neither character tries. Sharing the story becomes a discussion, with the listeners adding ideas of their own.

parallelText.en: The library invites our class to share a story from a book of literature.
parallelText.zh: 图书馆邀请我们班分享一本文学作品集中的故事。

parallelText.en: The story has two children who disagree about the way to a garden.
parallelText.zh: 故事里有两个孩子，对去花园的路线有不同意见。

parallelText.en: Mia and I act the parts of the children while another pupil reads the setting.
parallelText.zh: 米娅和我扮演两个孩子，另一位同学读背景介绍。

parallelText.en: We use different voices to show that one character is worried and the other is confident.
parallelText.zh: 我们用不同声音表现一个角色担忧、另一个自信。

parallelText.en: After the reading, younger visitors ask why the characters do not check a map together.
parallelText.zh: 读完后，较小的访客问，角色为什么不一起查地图。

parallelText.en: Their questions help us see a possible solution that neither character tries.
parallelText.zh: 这些问题让我们看到一个两位角色都没尝试的可能办法。

parallelText.en: Sharing the story becomes a discussion, with the listeners adding ideas of their own.
parallelText.zh: 分享故事变成了讨论，听众加入自己的想法。
